name: MagnaTagATune Dataset
description: MagnaTagATune is a music audio auto-tagging and classification benchmark consisting of 25,863 30-second audio clips sourced from Magnatune independent music. Annotated by players through the TagATune online two-player game, it provides binary tag vectors across 188 verified labels (instruments, genres, moods, tempo, and vocal traits), serving as a standard benchmark in music information retrieval (MIR).
